title: Rig clone PageSpec
description: Machine contract for a page composed from this design-repo. Structural/rhythm/compliance rules live in semantic_validate.py. 'maxWords' is a custom keyword enforced there.

route.description: Concrete internal route. Unknown /blog/<slug> values are the post template's not-found state.

theme.description: The site has one theme; the red hero is a brand surface inside it.

content.description: cta present on variant 'default' (red btn-cta), absent on 'default-no-cta' (/waitlist) - rule NAV_VARIANT_BY_ROUTE

nav.description: Header, hero variant (black logo, ink links, btn-dark CTA). Embedded in the hero: the homepage has no standalone shell.header node.

flow.description: 3-card severed flow: cloud -x- machine (active) -x- nothing leaves

fill.description: full cells of 20; a fraction adds a sliver; null = no bar

highlight.description: the Rig row: bright label, green bar + value

cards.description: one ASCII bar-chart card per step, same order

items.description: 3-col grid; the '[ 01 ]' labels are generated from the index

content.description: Exactly 8 .term-line rows: nth-child drives the reveal delays (Terminal.jsx comment)
